subject: maths
question: Calculate the area of a right-angled triangle with a base of 22 cm and height corresponding to that base is 15 cm.
solution:
**Given:**

Base of the right-angled triangle = 22 cm

Height corresponding to the base = 15 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of a right-angled triangle = (1/2) × base × height

**Calculation:**

Area = (1/2) × 22 cm × 15 cm

⇒ Area = (1/2) × 330 cm²

⇒ Area = 165 cm²

**The area of the right-angled triangle is 165 cm².**
